description: 阅读理解：基于课文的选择题，检验理解程度

questions.question: When was Grandma's birthday?
questions.questionCn: 奶奶的生日是什么时候？
questions.explanation: 课文说：Yesterday was 21st October. It was Grandma's 66th birthday. 昨天是10月21日，是奶奶的66岁生日。

questions.question: How old was Grandma?
questions.explanation: 课文说：It was Grandma's 66th birthday. 那是奶奶的第66个生日，也就是66岁。

questions.question: What did Wang Bing's parents give Grandma?
questions.questionCn: 王兵的父母送给奶奶什么？
questions.explanation: 课文说：His parents gave Grandma a nice smartphone. 他的父母送给奶奶一部漂亮的智能手机。

questions.question: What did Wang Bing draw for Grandma?
questions.explanation: 课文说：Wang Bing drew a picture for her. 王兵为她画了一幅画。

questions.question: Why did they eat noodles?

options.label: C
options.text: To wish Grandma a long life.

questions.explanation: 课文说：We ate noodles and wished Grandma a long life. 我们吃了面条，祝奶奶长寿。长长的面条象征长寿。

questions.question: What did Grandma do with the candles?
questions.explanation: 课文说：Then Grandma blew out the candles, and we ate the cake. 然后奶奶吹灭了蜡烛，我们吃了蛋糕。

questions.question: How many family photos did they have?
questions.explanation: 课文说：It was our 12th family photo. 那是我们的第12张全家福。

questions.question: What can we learn from the story?
questions.questionCn: 我们能从这个故事中学到什么？

options.label: B
options.text: We should spend more time with our grandparents.
options.textCn: 我们应该多陪陪爷爷奶奶。

options.label: D
options.text: We should eat cake every day.

questions.explanation: 课文最后说：I want to spend more time with them. 我想多陪陪他们。陪伴是对长辈最好的关爱。

questions.question: What festival is it in Cartoon time?
questions.explanation: 课文说：It is the Double Ninth Festival today. 今天是重阳节。

questions.question: When is the Double Ninth Festival?

options.label: A
options.text: On the first day of the first lunar month.

options.label: B
options.text: On the ninth day of the ninth lunar month.

options.label: C
options.text: On the 15th day of the 8th lunar month.

questions.explanation: 课文说：It's on the ninth day of the ninth lunar month. 它在农历九月初九。

questions.question: What is the Double Ninth Festival for?

options.label: B
options.text: It's a day for old people.

questions.explanation: 课文说：It's a day for old people. 这是老年人的节日。重阳节也叫敬老节。

questions.question: What do people do on the Double Ninth Festival?

options.label: B
options.text: They show love for their grandparents.

questions.explanation: 课文说：They show their love for their grandmothers and grandfathers. They give them gifts and do chores for them. 他们表达对爷爷奶奶的爱，给他们送礼物、做家务。

questions.question: What did Bobby and Tina plan to do for Grandpa?

options.label: A
options.text: Cook dinner and make a card.

questions.explanation: Tina说：We can cook dinner for him. Bobby说：We can make a card for him too. 他们计划做晚饭和做卡片。

questions.question: What did they say to Grandpa?

options.label: B
options.text: Happy Double Ninth Festival! We love you!

questions.explanation: 课文说：Happy Double Ninth Festival, Grandpa! We love you! 爷爷，重阳节快乐！我们爱您！

questions.question: What is the main idea of the unit?
questions.questionCn: 这个单元的主旨是什么？

options.label: C
options.text: We should show love and care for our family and the elderly.
options.textCn: 我们应该向家人和长辈表达爱与关怀。

questions.explanation: 无论是奶奶的生日还是重阳节，故事都告诉我们：要向家人和长辈表达爱与关怀，多陪伴他们。
